intro.text: Dunny is a member of Bridge Four in Sadeas's army.
Dunny is a shy, spindly young member of Bridge Four, who gains confidence after singing with Rock.

items.text: Dunny had been an apprentice before Bridge Four; his master beat him for forgetting to use proper titles.
On Kaladin's first run as bridgeleader, Dunny helped him tend the wounded, heating the knife Kaladin used to treat Leyten.
On stone-gathering duty, Dunny and Earless Jaks towed a large stone on a sled and helped Kaladin load it into the wagon.
On chasm duty, Rock told Dunny that on the Peaks every name is a poem. Dunny spoke one of his own, then sang it in a pure tenor with Rock harmonizing, and his shyness began to fade.
From then on, Dunny helped Rock with the stew, spoke up for Kaladin's plan to fight and escape, and even told the others about the first girl he kissed.

During a bridge run soon after, one of Sadeas's archers accidentally shot Dunny in the shoulder, and a Parshendi arrow then killed him before Kaladin could reach him. The loss hit Kaladin hard, and he remembered Dunny among those he had lost before swearing his Second Ideal.

appearance.text: Dunny is a dark-eyed, spindly, baby-faced youth who hardly needs to shave, skinnier than most of Bridge Four. Sigzil notes that his eyes are dark violet, hinting that he may be Veden.

personality.text: At first Dunny is very shy, but after singing with Rock on chasm duty he walks with more confidence and talks more with the others.
